description: Update the configuration of an existing MCP server. Merges provided updates into the existing config.

allow_footgun_args.description: Set true to override the safety refusal when updates.args include code-injection flags like -e/--eval/-c.

allow_footgun_env.description: Set true to override the safety refusal when updates.env sets a code-injection key like NODE_OPTIONS, LD_PRELOAD, PYTHONSTARTUP.

allow_shell_metacharacters.description: Set true to override the safety refusal when 'updates.command' contains shell metacharacters.

mcp_name.description: The name of the MCP server to configure

updates.description: Fields to update in the MCP server config

env.description: Environment variables to set or update

headers.description: HTTP headers for http/sse type servers

url.description: New URL for http/sse type servers

name: configure_mcp
